hypothesis: With the V3 data recipe fixed (60 trading days, raw 12-dim L1-L3 windows, CSZ labels, train_std scaling, 19,800 steps, seeds 11/29/47), the upstream dual-axis MLP trunk (MLPLOB, no attention) may match or beat the TLOB trunk; the comparison is an equal-weight three-seed ensemble scored on the same validation window. Guardrails are carried over unchanged from the V3 arm study (minimum +0.0023 RankIC, turnover ceiling 1.3211) and are not fitted here.

decision.rule: promote mlplob_v3 only if the paired RankIC gain >= 0.0023, its 5-day block interval excludes zero, and ensemble turnover <= 1.3211; otherwise retain v3_shuffle19800 as the submission baseline
